diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions that produce no observable state change, especially clicks, no-ops, and scrolls.
expected_mechanism: A retry cap plus mandatory re-observation should convert unproductive loops into diagnosis or strategy changes, improving completion efficiency. Cost: extra state checks and occasional premature stopping when a repeated action might eventually succeed.
policy_text: After an action yields no observable state change, do not repeat the same or functionally equivalent action more than once. Re-observe state, diagnose the blocker, and switch strategy, target, or tool; if no materially different option exists, stop and report the constraint.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated") | [.labels.comparison_side[0],.value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{v=$2<0?-$2:$2; n[$1]+=v} END{for(s in n) print s,n[s]}' | sort
quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated-result operations: candidate/bad 1,485 versus base/good 224, a +1,261 excess and 6.63× raw count.
